note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (generic liability categories, never real contract text). The substitution changes one supplied datum (the status of one category: 'Category included' ↔ 'Exclusion to be reviewed', ● and ◆ alike); only the contour beside that tile follows. No doctrine on limitation or exclusion clauses: no enforceability, validity or effect, no cap or amount, no outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the context is the delimited sheet; the clause heading is shown), schedules, definitions, priorities, actorLabels (no actors), objectLabels (the props carry no names), finalState (the hold is the after-value with the changed marker).
